privacy.title: Before you start
privacy.subtitle: Privacy notice · Law 18-07
privacy.heading: What Minhajna keeps, and where
privacy.intro: A short notice before first use, always available in Help.
privacy.phoneText: Lists, roll calls, marks and record books are stored encrypted on the device. No account or internet is needed.
privacy.leaveText: This version does not connect to the internet, and does not ask for permission to. Pupils’ data never goes into the phone’s cloud backups.
privacy.neverText: No health, disability, religion or photos of pupils, no information about parents, and no addresses. An absence is excused or not, with no reason given.
privacy.trackingText: No ads, no analytics, no record of hours or location, and no crash reports.
privacy.publisherText: The open-source Minhajna project. This version connects to none of its servers.
privacy.rightsText: To see what the project holds about you, and to have it corrected and deleted within 10 days.

connections.title: What the app connects to, and why
connections.none: This version does not connect to the internet: it asks for no permission to, and sends and receives nothing.
connections.source: The source code link in Licences opens only after you confirm. Your browser opens it outside the app, with no record or identifier.
connections.register: Any connection the project adds is listed in the NETWORK.md file of the source code, with what is sent and why, before it reaches the app.
